hero.title: Your front desk, ready to take the call.
hero.body: Your AI receptionist handles inbound phone calls in English, Hindi and Telugu. It answers front-desk questions, helps with bookings, transfers to your team and turns after-hours voicemails into callback tickets.
hero.reassurance: Real phone calls. Three languages. A person when needed.

seo.title: AI receptionist for phone calls | Steps AI
seo.description: Answer inbound calls with an AI receptionist that books appointments, transfers to your team and turns after-hours calls into callback tickets.

walkthrough.title: One call, handled.
walkthrough.intro: An inbound call to a clinic.

steps.label: Greet the caller
steps.customer: Hello, is the clinic open on Saturday?
steps.agent: Hello, yes, we are open on Saturday from 9 to 1. Would you like to book?
steps.note: Known callers are greeted by name.

steps.label: Book the visit
steps.agent: Saturday at 11 is booked. You will get a confirmation.
steps.note: Bookings go into your connected calendar.

steps.label: Transfer when needed
steps.customer: Can I speak to the doctor about my report?
steps.agent: Of course, I will transfer you to the team now.
steps.note: Calls can be transferred to a person.

capabilities.title: What your AI receptionist can do.
capabilities.intro: A focused role for your voice agent: look after incoming callers and their next step.

items.title: Answer inbound calls
items.body: Calls are routed to the right agent by the number dialled.

items.title: Speak three languages
items.body: English, Hindi and Telugu, with a greeting you can preview.

items.title: Take messages after hours
items.body: Calls outside business hours leave a voicemail that becomes a callback ticket.

items.title: Transfer to your team
items.body: Connect the caller with a person when they need help from your team.

items.title: Keep a record
items.body: Calls appear in the inbox with recordings stored.

tools.title: Works with your calendar.
tools.intro: Bookings go where your team already plans.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: You connect a telephony provider from the dashboard.
Voice minutes are billed as credits.

items.a: English, Hindi and Telugu. You can also lock an agent to one language.
Callers can leave a voicemail, which becomes a callback ticket for your team.

cta.title: See the AI receptionist with your own business in mind.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through it using your own information and channels.
